title: I am looking for fantasy tilesets that are compatible with the character builder

posts.author: MindlessForMinerva
posts.body:
Could I please get some links to fantasy tilesets that mesh well with the sprites from the character builder?
Thank you!

posts.author: SeaPhoenix
posts.body:
You may find that you'll get better answers using this form for resource requests:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/resource-request-form.49495/
In particular, which version of RPG Maker are you using, and what other versions do you own? (Since if you own MV, you can use MV tilesets even in MZ, etc.)
